data.name: MapDescription
data.value: A map drawn by the package itself, from the tiles of a server the host chooses (OpenStreetMap by default): lines in stretches of their own colour with a tooltip, markers that are real buttons, drag to pan, wheel, double click, buttons and keys to zoom, a click that gives its place, and a framing of the whole content.

data.name: MapFitDescription
data.value: Frames every line and marker; turned off, the map stays where it is.

data.name: MapPreviewDescription
data.value: A route through Brussels in five-minute stretches, each coloured by the rain forecast at the time of passage. Point at a stretch to read its forecast, drag the map, zoom with the wheel or the buttons, click the map to read its place, press a marker. With the map focused, the arrows pan and + and - zoom.
